Experience
FirstAdvantage Corporation, US (Earlier Sterling Check Corp US) -– IT Project Manager – July 2023 – Present - Bangalore and Remote - Concurrently leading 5 high impact strategic complex projects for APAC region. 
  Leading Salesforce Account enrichment, hierarchies, reporting and cleanup
Project and Customer Journey project, managing project team spread across US,
Canada, UK, Singapore, Spain, India, Philippines and Australia involving
workstreams of Revenue Tech (Systems and Data), Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Engineering, QA and UAT, Product Marketing and Sales, Finance and Billing, Communication and Change management, Vendors such as Zoominfo, and Neuraflash.
 Lead Strategic client migration and new business enablement project for APAC targeting a $25m of run rate cost savings involving migration of acquired clients
through M&A who are using proprietary legacy apps depending on manual order processing and hosted using on-prem infra to robust cloud based Sterling
platforms to achieve enhanced customer experience and realize saving in COGS by way of automation, online integration and standardization of client service
processes.
Lead Sterling ACIC Client migration project, where 80+ APAC clients who had a requirement for the verification services availed from Sterling had to be ACIC compliant where candidate data need to reside within Australia as a data residency requirement due to regulatory changes from Australia NCCHC, clients requiring ACIC verification had to be migrated from a Legacy RISQ AmyA platform (Sterling had acquired RISQ Corp) to Sterling Screening Direct(SD) AU hosted platform.
Lead EA ACIC Client migration project, when First Advantage(FA) acquired Sterling(ST), the ACIC clients of FA had similar need as above so are being migrated from FA EA platform to Legacy ST SD AU hosted platform.
Lead EMEA Client Migration project, here clients requiring Australia ACIC verification service are being migrated to Legacy ST SD AU hosted platform and others to ST SD US (United States) platform.
Lead Salesforce Data Improvement project to address data deduplication requirements for merging FA and Sterling client accounts, leads and opportunities.
Lead Salesforce shield project to achieve Encryption, Event Monitoring, and Field Audit tracking to enhance data security, compliance and governance.
Lead Smartsheet FA Roadmap project to evaluate cost implication of new
licensing model, compare alternatives considering change management fatigue and business impact, address user administration challenges.
Managed a team size of ~80 spanning across US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Malaysia, Philippines, India and Australia which consisted of Head of Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance and Billing, Client and candidate care, Customer success,
Product development, Report generation and analytics, Training, Quality assurance, Professional services group and SME for client migrations, Legal and compliance, IT, Cyber security and privacy and Customer service.
Conduct weekly, bi-weekly, fortnightly, workstream level and broader project level standup calls across PST, CST, EST, GMT, SGT, IST and AET time zones.
Present 4 square weekly project progress to the executive transformation steering committee and discuss on risks and mitigation plans.
Lead RISQ Corp IT integration to Sterling IT project with a team size of 35,
involving 5 data centres, GSuit, file and proprietary customer facing application servers, spanning 8 countries (Australia, Malaysia, Hong Kong, China, Philippines, Singapore and India )
Ensuring successful project compliance to Sterling corporate privacy, PII data handling, change management, security and IT standards during planning, execution and project closure are followed and artifacts secured.
Lead Strategic China Ring Fence project for M&A business integration working with senior executive leadership team spanning across US, HK, MY, PH and China.
Plan, Design, Execute and Track various project and workstream level progress reporting requirements following Sterling Transformation Office frameworks, tools, methodologies and templates for all the above projects.
Leverage all the project management and collaboration tools such as Smartsheet, MS Teams, MS SharePoint, JIRA, O365 Suit, internal portals etc. Create and maintain RACI and Risk log.
Fostering a culture of collaboration within the team, training and coaching project team for accurate and timely progress and risk reporting, assume ownership and
accountability for accepted tasks.
BPL Medical Technologies Pvt Ltd. (A Goldman Sachs Portfolio Company) - Senior Manager – Information Technology - August 2021 – Jan 2022 - Bangalore -
Reported to CFO at BPL Medical technologies, did head all India IT infrastructure on an end to end basis transforming their IT to meet global standards, driving numerous projects created technology, security, data protection, compliance and end user computing roadmaps. Managed budgets, vendors, procurements, assets, FMS, service providers and end user
experience. Created and enforced policies and standards. Provided IT consultation and training to business and staff organization.

Windows NT,2000,2003,2008,2012 and

HTML etc, MS Office (MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Access and Visio), Vulnerability mgmt, Data Loss Prevention, Disaster Recovery, Data Center relocation, Data Protection, Service Continuity.
IT Infrastructure Project management and Consulting – Freelance - Oct-2015 – Aug 2021 - Bangalore and Remote - During this period of exploration into startup ventures, the freelance industry, and ventures outside of my comfort zone, I embarked on several notable assignments and projects as follows.
Pippin Technologies – Project Manager - Remote (US) Reported to Head of product, lead variety of projects such as GDPR, Pricing, Vendor expansion, projects for improving business processes and operational efficiency.
Mondelez International - Project Manager -Freelance Remote (UK) Lead global Bigfix MDM project for EUC organization involving 45K+ Windows systems and 17K+ Tablets, Agile, Scrum and Tollgate methodology based project management.
Freelance IT Infrastructure consulting on a broad spectrum, AWS S3, Cloud front, SSL certificates, domain registrations and configurations etc,
Exposure to various Industry verticals, financial markets and Science streams.
3M India Ltd - Manager IT - India Region July 2005 - Oct 2015 –Bangalore – Major achievement during this period are as below. 
Architected and Implemented DR/BCP for 3M India and Sri Lanka compliant with 3M Global ITSCP framework, Feel At Office SSL portal, Servers, ESXi virtualization, network, backup, storage projects.
Wireless and WLC implementation, ITIL based ITSM implementation, Lead security dashboard projects for India region and implemented ISO27001/2 Standards.
DC Transformation for 3M Pune Plant (India) and 3M Sri Lanka HQ, Virtualization and application consolidations, 3M India BPO integration. Transforming IT help desk and service delivery for the region, MS Azure MFA for India region, Citrix to WTS migration.
Managed projects involving in house developers, 3M GDC, external development vendors, SaaS, PaaS, IaaS vendors, domestic and international application, ERP, CRM, DB and Infrastructure service providers and vendors. Enterprise application and desktop virtualization for mobile platform,
3M Cogent India and 3M Digital Signage IT integration. Conducted IT induction programs for new employees and technology, security and compliance sessions for business leaders and users.
Lead CoE’s for End User Computing (EUC), Mobility, Servers, Network,
Security, Messaging, Storage, Digital IT for India region. Lead entire IT for 3M Sri Lanka remotely.
Worked closely with CXOs and country business leaders, delivered as an IT Business relationship manager for Healthcare division, R&D, HR and acted as a SPOC for all their strategic, projects and operational IT requirements.
Managed 20+ resources including FTE, contract, outsourced, direct, functional, global and dotted line.
